reference.source: reference/images/curated/gameplay — 11 curated Brawl Stars / Zooba plates
reference.method: tools/tmp/chroma.mjs, reproduced exactly by colourBudget() below

rails.label: mean saturation
rails.note: below 0.302 is the reading three critics called muddy; every plate is >= 0.370

rails.label: warm chroma 0-60
rails.note: absolute, not a share. 0.067 = the recorded overshoot

rails.label: cool chroma 60-360
rails.note: adding cool is the cheap lever — LESSONS §8

rails.label: mean chroma
rails.note: max-min per pixel; the raw colourfulness of the frame

rails.label: warm share of chroma
rails.note: the reference reserves the warm half for the cast

rails.label: ENV warm share
rails.note: CEILING 0.297 = the reference whole-frame warm share INCLUDING its cast; an environment alone above it is out of contract. Lower is always better — warm is reserved for the cast.

rails.label: cast/env hue overlap
rails.note: SUM min(castShare,envShare) over 12 bins. 0 = disjoint hue occupancy

rails.label: ENV chroma in cast band
rails.note: fraction of environment chroma inside the cast dominant bin +/-30 deg

rails.label: (arena only) mean sat
rails.note: the HUD is 13.4% of frame; this is the arena on its own

rails.label: (arena only) warm chroma
rails.note: ~25% of whole-frame warm chroma is HUD furniture, not arena
